y-m-20-07.topic: Ma quadrant e coordinate plane nezviratidzo zvemapeya akarongwa
y-m-20-07.goal: Kubva pamamiriro pachiratidzo che product nepa absolute value, funga kuti poinzi inogona kuva mu quadrant dzipi, uye ratidza nemienzaniso inopikisa nyaya apo mamiriro asingatari rimwe chete.
y-m-20-07.material: Ngatitii coordinates dzepoinzi P ndi (a, b), apo a ne b ndema integer kubva ku-9 kusvika ku9. Pane mamiriro maviri. Pakutanga, product ab ye a ne b iri pasi pe0. Chechipiri, absolute value ya a yakakura kupfuura absolute value ya b. (Absolute value ndicho chinhambwe kuenda ku0 pa number line.) Quadrant 1 ndiko apo x-coordinate ne y-coordinate zvose ziri positive, quadrant 2 apo x-coordinate iri negative uye y-coordinate iri positive, quadrant 3 apo zvose zviri negative, uye quadrant 4 apo x-coordinate iri positive uye y-coordinate iri negative. Seojin akafunga nzvimbo yepoinzi P kubva pamamiriro maviri seizvi pazasi.

y-m-20-07.s.s1.line.1: Kana a iri negative uye b iri positive, poinzi (a, b) iri mu Quadrant 2.
y-m-20-07.s.s1.line.2: Kana a iri positive uye b iri negative, poinzi (a, b) iri mu Quadrant 4.
y-m-20-07.s.s1.line.3: |a|>|b| zvinoreva kuti a, ine absolute value huru, ipositive, saka nyaya apo a iri positive chete ndiyo inogoneka.
y-m-20-07.s.s1.line.4: Saka poinzi (a, b) iri mu Quadrant 4.
